skill.title: Test whether a point is on a line; find intercepts

note: Use the SAME method as the references: substitute the point into the equation of the line and check whether both sides are equal, then say whether the point is on the line. Write 1 problem where the point IS on the line (finalSym 0 for LHS - RHS is fine). Do not read points off a grid.

steps.title: Substitute x = -2 and y = -5 into x - y - 3

lines.text: The left side equals $0$, so $T$ is on $k$.

steps.title: Pick a value for x and find y

lines.text: Choose $x = 1$ and put it into $x - y - 3 = 0$.

steps.title: Read the point from the graph

lines.text: Read across to the $x$-value first, then up to the $y$-value. $F$ is 4 across and 1 up.
